text:
Mara: Quick design check — inline suppression preview empty state in the compact threshold editor. When you toggle 'Preview suppressions' while no channels are selected, current mock shows a large illustration + 'No channels configured'. Wanted opinions on: copy, height/compactness, keyboard focus, and a11y announcement behavior. Jason: Short answer — shrink it. Compact editor should not be dominated by art. Replace big illustration with a small icon + two-line helper copy, and a primary 'Add channel' button. Keep a subtle 'Manage channels' link. Sophia: Accessibility notes: the preview open/close should announce via aria-live so screen reader users know state changed. Also ensure the toggle has aria-expanded and that focus lands on the first actionable control (probably 'Add channel') when preview opens. Aisha: Slight product question — we have two empty cases: (1) org has zero channels at all, (2) user has channels but none selected for this rule. Copy should make that distinction. For (1) suggest: 'No notification channels exist yet. Create a channel to see routing previews.' For (2): 'No channels selected for this alert. Add one to preview routing.' Mara: Good call. I'm leaning to a single compact component that adapts copy based on channel count. Visual proposal: 120–140px high container, left-side icon (bell/empty stack), right-side copy + action. No big illustration. DesignBot: Contrast check — button needs 4.5:1 against background in compact mode. Also ensure icon color meets 3:1 against container if decorative is relied on for state. Jason: For keyboard flow, when preview opens via the toggle, do not move focus to the toggle. Instead programmatically focus the 'Add channel' CTA if it's present; otherwise focus the 'Create channel' link. That feels more useful. Sophia: Example aria snippet for the live announcement:```html
Notification preview opened. No channels configured.
```Place that immediately after the toggle so SR users get the context. Also add sr-only text to the toggle: 'opens notification preview'. Mara: Copy options (short): - Case A (no channels in org): 'No notification channels yet. Create one to see where alerts will go.' + CTA 'Create channel' - Case B (channels exist, none selected): 'No channels selected for this rule. Add a channel to preview routing.' + CTA 'Add channel' Which phrasing feels less confusing to non-admins? Jason: I prefer 'Add channel' for rule-level flow — less admin-y. Use 'Create channel' only in org admin contexts. Aisha: Small nit: 'preview routing' might not be clear to new users. Maybe 'see who gets notified' as a subtitle. Eg: 'Add a channel to see who gets notified when this alert fires.' Mara: Good microcopy tweak. Final proposal: compact empty state (120px) with bell icon, heading (case-specific), single-line helper copy: 'Add a channel to see who gets notified.' Primary CTA 'Add channel' (or 'Create channel' if no channels exist). aria-live polite announcement when opened. Focus management moves to CTA. Sophia: LGTM for accessibility, just ensure we test with NVDA/VoiceOver keyboard-only. Jason: I'll mock reduced-height version in Figma and share before EOD. Mara: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll update the spec doc and ping @Jason for the Figma link. If no objections I'll ship these changes to the threshold-editor PR later today :thumbsup: Jason: :thumbsup: (reacted) Aisha: tiny follow-up: can we add an analytics event when a user opens the preview and when they click CTA? Useful to measure how many users have channels vs not. Mara: Yes — adding events: preview_opened, preview_cta_click, preview_no_channels_shown. Noted. DesignBot: Accessibility checklist added to the spec: aria-live, aria-expanded, keyboard focus path, contrast ratios. Mara: Perfect. I'll post updated screenshots in this thread once pushed.
